title: Calculation Sheet: Departure Rollover Amount Credited to a Sibling's School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
**Amount.** The departure rollover amount for a receiving School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds twenty (20) serving days, a full school month, of one reimbursable lunch at the lunch charge the departure rollover counts, with nothing else added, less the account's balance, so a negative balance adds its unpaid meal charges to the departure rollover.

**Lunch charge.** The lunch charge the departure rollover counts is the student's charge under the district's meal pricing at the account's campus: the secondary lunch charge of the student's meal status at Ridgecrest Middle School, Calloway Creek High School or Mesquite Ridge High School, and the elementary lunch charge of the status at any other campus not listed as a CEP campus.

**Balance.** The receiving account's balance for the departure rollover is its deposits, voids and transfers in less its purchases, refunds, transfers out and returned deposits, as they stand when the departure rollover is made.

**Assembly.** First every charge counted for each serving day is added together into the day charge; then the day charge is multiplied by the serving days counted and every amount counted once is added; then the receiving account's balance is subtracted. The departure rollover amount is that total, never below nothing, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; a departure rollover of zero moves nothing.

## Worked amounts (hypothetical receiving accounts)

| Receiving account | Twenty lunches | Balance | Departure rollover amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid Meal Status at Bluebonnet Trail Elementary (3.10) | 62.00 | 9.95 | 52.05 |
| Paid Meal Status at Ridgecrest Middle School (3.45) | 69.00 | 3.00 below zero | 72.00 |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status at Alder Springs Elementary (0.40) | 8.00 | 11.30 | 0.00, nothing moves |
